index_sql:
CREATE INDEX lookup_order ON translations(
                dataset_id,source_locale,target_locale,source_key COLLATE BINARY,
                source_text COLLATE BINARY,target_text COLLATE BINARY,id)

exact: SEARCH main.translations USING INDEX lookup_order (dataset_id=? AND source_locale=? AND target_locale=? AND source_key=?)
prefix: SEARCH main.translations USING COVERING INDEX lookup_order (dataset_id=? AND source_locale=? AND target_locale=? AND source_key>? AND source_key<?)
infix: SEARCH main.translations USING COVERING INDEX lookup_order (dataset_id=? AND source_locale=? AND target_locale=?)
